character_sheet: A night-flying moth on the shared butterfly rig: a one-cube body bar, a one-cube head, and four flat wing panels a side — inner and outer forewings, a hindwing and a long tail streamer (ButterflyModel.createBodyLayer, ButterflyModel.java:54-102), drawn half again as large as the butterfly in one of four moth skins (LunaMothRenderer.java:23, :39-43). It is a butterfly subclass (EntityLunaMoth.java:24) whose flight goal seeks torches when it is sheltered from the sky (LunaMothFlightGoal, registered at :55) and still carries the Islands hunt of its parent, so in the Islands it nips prey for 1.0 on a 1-in-2 roll (EntityButterfly.doHurtTarget, EntityButterfly.java:161-165). It hovers a little heavier than the butterfly (the vertical drag at tick :58-63), spawns only at night, in the air, above y 50 or anywhere in the Islands (checkSpawnRules :66-73) in jungle and taiga swarms (the swarm_luna_moth biome modifiers), and twenty of them burst from Mothra when she dies (Mothra.java:468-475). Read it as a soft, slower flutter than the butterfly's.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.5 of the rig (LunaMothRenderer.java:23, applied at :33-35; shadow 0.4 x 1.5) on the shared 64x32 sheet (ButterflyModel.java:104), four skins by moth_type (LunaMothRenderer.java:39-43: lunamoth / eyemoth / darkmoth / firemoth); 0.5 x 0.5 block hitbox (ModEntities.java:606-608). The wing panels are one unit thick.

groups.name: wings
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.25 = 0.785 rad (45 deg) each way; the four left panels the negative of the four right panels
groups.plain: the eight wing panels flap about the body's long axis together, 45 degrees up and down, the left side mirroring the right, at three quarters of the butterfly's rate; nothing else moves
groups.math: rightwing.zRot = rightwing2.zRot = rightwing3.zRot = rightwing4.zRot = cos(ageInTicks * 1.3 * 0.75) * pi * 0.25; leftwing*.zRot = -rightwing.zRot
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.3 x wingspeed 0.75 (two float multiplies, left to right) = 0.975 rad/tick: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.975 = 6.44 ticks

behaviour: One rhythm runs at all times: the eight wing panels roll about the body's long axis at 0.975 rad/tick (a 6.44-tick beat — the butterfly's 1.3 scaled by this renderer's wingspeed 0.75, LunaMothRenderer.java:29), 45 degrees each way, the left set mirroring the right (ButterflyModel.java:109-115). The body and the head are static; the walk position, the walking speed, the head angles and the entity's state play no part.

The flight is the entity's: LunaMothFlightGoal (EntityLunaMoth.java:55) steers the delta movement toward torches when sheltered and wanders on the butterfly preset otherwise, and tick :58-63 damps the vertical speed by 0.6 each tick. The model never banks or bobs the body with that motion.
The renderer draws the head, then the body, then the wing pairs inner to outer (renderToBuffer, ButterflyModel.java:119-130).

The `attack` row is offered from the inherited nip: LunaMothFlightGoal extends ButterflyIslandsHuntGoal (LunaMothFlightGoal.java:43), whose :83 calls EntityButterfly.doHurtTarget (EntityButterfly.java:161-165) — the trigger inventory follows the registered goal's parent class now (TEST-011); the nip's clip is left unauthored (verdict `leave` below) until the owner decides whether it earns a strike clip when the rig lands.

in `idle`: wings held flat and trembling, a moth settled by a torch (LunaMothFlightGoal seeks torches under cover)
a tail-streamer lag: `leftwing4` / `rightwing4` trailing a few degrees behind the panels instead of rolling rigidly with them
locked_bones_note: The design's section 6 ButterflyModel row (geckolib_migration_design.md:440) keeps this consumer single-box — 'butterfly / luna_moth [0.4,0.4] ... stay single-box', 'other shared-rig consumers get no profile' — so no intended locked bones are pre-declared; the row's four part bones (body, head, leftwing, rightwing) belong to mothra's profile only. Every bone name stays final regardless (the shared rig serves four registries).
formulas: `ButterflyModel.setupAnim` (ButterflyModel.java:108-116; orig ModelButterfly.java:96-102 in `render` (func_78088_a, :91-111 - the head and body drawn at :94-95, the eight wing rotations written at :96-102, the eight wings drawn at :103-110; func_78087_a at :119-121 is a bare super call), wingspeed 0.75 - `new ModelButterfly(0.75f)` in orig ClientProxyOreSpawn.java:407): the four right wing parts (rightwing, rightwing2, rightwing3, rightwing4) roll about Z by the cosine of the age in ticks times 1.3 times the wingspeed (two float multiplies, left to right), times pi, times 0.25, and the four left wing parts (leftwing, leftwing2, leftwing3, leftwing4) by its negative; the body and the head are still. The walk position, the walking speed, the head angles and the entity's state play no part.
